content: पदविः, -वी {%f.%} [पद्-अवि वा ङीप] .²1 A way, road, path, course (<ab>fig.</ab> also); पवनपदवी <ls>Me. 8</ls>; अनुयाहि साधुपदवीम् <ls>Bh. 2. 77</ls> ‘follow in the footsteps of the good’; <ls>Ś. 4. 14</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 50</ls>, <ls n="R.">7. 7</ls>, <ls n="R.">8. 11</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 99</ls>; <ls>Bh. 3. 46</ls>; <ls>Ve. 6. 27</ls>; so स यौवनपदवीमारूढः <ls>Pt. 1</ls>, ‘he attained his majority’ (grew up to manʼs estate). .²2 Position, station, rank, dignity, office, post; एतत् स्तोत्रं प्रपठता विचार्य गुरुवाक्यतः . प्राप्यते ब्रह्मपदवी सत्यं सत्यं न संशयः .. <ls>Tattvamasi Stotra. 12</ls>. .²3 A place, site. .²4 Good conduct or behaviour.
